about_the_game:
✈️ Plane Balance : Smugglers or Saints?

Pack it. Risk it. Send it.

You’re a freelance pilot with one dream: earn enough money to buy your cozy lakeside house with a private airfield and retire happily with your otter companion. But how you get there…or will you get there??? is up to you.

Do you play it safe, delivering legal cargo for steady pay? Or do you risk it all smuggling shady packages for big profits and bigger consequences?

🧩 Gameplay Features

  • Tetris-Style Packing – Every job gives you oddly-shaped packages to fit into your plane’s cargo grid. Keep things balanced or lose money due to rough flight

  • Risk vs. Reward – Legal deliveries are safe but low-paying. Illegal cargo can make you rich — if you don’t get caught.

  • Custom Inspections – Customs officers check random cargo slots for contraband. If they find something shady, kiss your payout goodbye.

  • Wanted Status – Build a bad reputation and you’ll attract special police raids. You’ll get warnings, but can you notice them in time?

  • Choose Your Path – Honest pilot or daring smuggler? Your choices shape your career and reputation.

🦦 Your Otter Companion

  • Always by your side, cheering (or squeaking nervously) as you stack your plane full.

  • Reacts to risky decisions.

  • Relax with your otter at home, and share quiet moments away from the hustle.

🏡 The Big Goal

Earn enough money to:

  • Discover new places to unlock new planes and customers.

  • Buy new planes with larger cargo grids and hidden compartments.

  • Finally purchase your dream lake house — your happily-ever-after.

🎨 Style & Vibe

A cozy, colorful, casual puzzle-sim with a cheeky sense of humor. Chill gameplay mixed with suspenseful moments when inspectors and special police come knocking.

content_descriptors.notes: This game includes generic, non-branded icons representing tobacco, alcohol, and narcotics. These are symbolic only — no characters, including the player, use or consume them in the game.
